axes.concept: A spatial consultation workspace: a local plan index beside one continuous four-panel comparison sheet; the optional selector highlights an informational comparison only.
axes.layout: At >=1100px a 216px left rail sits beside a ruled 2-by-2 sheet. At 640-1099px the rail becomes an upper dock and the sheet stays two columns. Below 640px plan panels stack.
axes.navigation: Preserved access/account entry links and masthead; a neutral in-page comparison/selection rule; anchor index in comparison changes into pressed-state choice buttons in selection, with a persistent full-comparison return.
axes.typography: Existing embedded Geist Sans and Geist Mono only. Page 24px, plan heading 20px, tabular monthly price 22px (20px phone), tools 14px, availability 12px. No display typography.
axes.density: One outer 32px sheet with shared rules, 24px peer-panel insets (20px phone) and compact fully visible cumulative tool lists. A narrow catalogue index keeps the main working area distinct from navigation.
axes.components: Real installed shadcn/Base UI Button, Input and Skeleton; source-compatible ring-and-dot masthead and account disclosure. Native buttons/anchors form the plan dock; no plan-tools disclosure.
axes.colour: Unchanged Pictures globals.css semantic palette in both themes; source accent marks only the comparison selection/focus/links, neutral paper and navigation, existing warning token labels unavailable tools.
axes.motion: Opposing spatial entrance: rail translates from -16px while plan quadrants arrive from +22px with 45ms staggering; expressive 440ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1). Selection has a shared spring marker and a short underline settle. Reduced motion and still=1 settle immediately. The comparison starts with an animated reference marker and highlighted-plan label on Entusiasta; no comparison choice or account assignment is seeded.
